title: Baseplate
metaDescription: Baseplate mode - open world sandbox with your character and phone controller. Play multiplayer in your browser.
markdown:
## Baseplate Mode

Simple open baseplate world. Spawn with your character, use keyboard or the on-screen phone-style joystick controller on mobile.

### Controls
- **WASD / Arrow keys**: Move
- **Space**: Jump
- **Mouse**: Look around (click to lock)
- **E**: Interact
- **Mobile**: Use the joystick GUI

Join and explore!
